title: The Fitting ideal of the strict transform along the blowup in that ideal
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the top Fitting ideal of the strict transform of a finite module along the blowup in the Fitting ideal: it becomes the unit ideal. The proof first observes that the Fitting ideal of the base changed module is the extension of the original Fitting ideal, and that this extension is principal inside the blowup algebra. Then, using the description of the principal Fitting ideal together with exactness of localisation, the strict transform is shown to be generated by at most the required number of elements at every prime, which by the local characterisation of Fitting ideals means the top Fitting ideal is the whole ring.
